description: This Python source file defines the class `BedrockPassthroughConfig`, which extends multiple base classes to implement AWS Bedrock LLM passthrough and transformation functionalities. It includes methods for URL formatting, request signing, response logging, byte stream conversion, and handling for streaming chunks, focused on AWS Bedrock integration within an LLM framework.
